title: [glm] build failure - SHA512 hash mismatch

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
### Operating system

Windows 11 10.0.22621.3155 x64 Enterprise

### Compiler
Visual Studio Community 2022 Version: [17.9.2]  VS Tools Version: [14.39.33519]
Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version [19.39.33521] for x64 

### Vcpkg Information
Vcpkg Version [2024-02-27-29a99e84b4d7bf30e43466b1572ea6b392dcf4e3] 
Vcpkg Scripts Version [2024-02-27-3dd44b931481d7a8e9ba412621fa810232b66289] 

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

```Shell
`.\vcpkg.exe install glm`
```

      1. You are actually using an HTTP proxy, but setting HTTPS_PROXY variable

### Additional context

I downloaded the file manually and checked SHA512 with hashtools.

The SHA512 from the downloaded file is `c6c6fa1ea7a7e97820e36ee042a78be248ae828c99c1b1111080d9bf334a5160c9993a70312351c92a867cd49907c95f9f357c8dfe2bc29946da6e83e27ba20c` which matches the one reported by vcpkg as being incorrect, does not match the SHA512 from the `portfile.cmake` of `0296a9bac8a114f50aa719b402d66524a4028aeec72649da1964faa80116f3f1ae5fa13d741dbaf9f4bcdb0722c0e44a4e85e8fc16dda641f4ba03f4a2c755d3`
